summary: Morgan Stanley Capital I Trust 2018-L1 filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that effective May 7, 2026, Torchlight Loan Services, LLC was appointed special servicer for the Griffin Portfolio II Non-Serviced Loan Combination under the BANK 2018-BNK13 PSA, replacing Mount Street US (Georgia) LLP. The appointment was made at the direction of Deer Park Road Management Company, LP. The filing does not relate to any special-situation category, as it is a routine servicing update for a commercial mortgage-backed securities trust. No deal terms, shareholder vote, or strategic event is involved.
